entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands an impressive undead minotaur.*#WHITE#
I would like to talk to you.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一位引人注目的亡灵米诺陶。*#WHITE#
我有一些话想对你说。

entries.source: A mage who has studied all there is to know about the stars and their working.
entries.target: 一个已通晓星辰及其运行之理的法师。

entries.source: The wretched titan's skin is of a sickly green, full of ever-oozing wounds, cracks and pustules. Worms and all kind of vile things crawl over it.
entries.target: 这个恶心的泰坦皮肤呈病态的绿色，满是不停渗液的伤口、裂缝和脓疱。蠕虫和其他各种污秽之物在他身上爬来爬去。

entries.source: It is a cross between a human and a bull, but more ... dead.
entries.target: 它是人类与公牛的混种，只不过更……死一些。

entries.source: This big undead minotaur is carrying a nasty looking hammer, imbued with lightning.
entries.target: 这个巨大的亡灵米诺陶拿着一把灌注了闪电的可怕巨锤。

entries.source: This humanoid form is coated with a thick white fur.
entries.target: 这个类人生物身上长着厚实的白毛。

entries.source: This large humanoid form is coated with a thick white fur.
entries.target: 这个大型的类人生物身上长着厚实的白毛。

entries.source: This huge humanoid form is coated with a thick white fur, with large, vicious claws. It looks angry.
entries.target: 这个巨大的类人生物身上长着厚实的白毛，和危险的巨爪。他看上去十分愤怒。

entries.source: This huge humanoid form is coated with a thick white fur, with large, vicious claws. Will you welcome the embrace of its large muscular arms?
entries.target: 这个巨大的类人生物身上长着厚实的白毛，和危险的巨爪。你会喜欢被他肌肉满满的双臂拥抱一下吗？

entries.source: Steamtech implants can be grafted on the users skin..
entries.target: 蒸汽科技的植入物可以移植到使用者皮肤上……

entries.source: A hat made of leather. Very stylish.
Schematics are used by tinkers to learn how to build new constructs.
entries.target: 工匠通过配方学习如何制造新的构造物。

entries.source: learn how to build this tinker
You can not learn schematics without knowing how to craft items.
entries.target: 你不会制造物品，无法学习这个配方。
你已经学会了这个配方。

entries.source: A stylish kruk-style cloak, to look awesome.
entries.target: 一件时髦的克鲁克风格披风，让你看起来很酷。
前往工匠洞穴的传送器

entries.source: A strange metal contraption imbued with some kind of teleportation magic.
entries.target: 一种带有某种传送魔法的奇怪金属装置。

entries.source: The teleporter's delicate systems are perturbed by foes on this level. You must have no foes left to be able to use it.
entries.target: 传送器的精密系统被这个楼层中的敌人扰乱了。你必须在没有敌人的情况下使用。

entries.source: Steamguns use bursts of steam directly injected in the barrel to propel metal shots with great force.
entries.target: 蒸汽枪将一股股蒸汽直接注入枪管，以巨大的力量推射金属弹丸。
